title: Debate as Reward: A Multi-Agent Reward System for Scientific Ideation via RL Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2604.16723v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated potential in automating scientific ideation, yet current approaches relying on iterative prompting or complex multi-agent architectures often suffer from hallucination or computational inefficiency. A critical bottleneck in applying Reinforcement Learning (RL) to this open-ended domain is reward hacking---where models exploit imperfect evaluation proxies to maximize scores without producing genuine scientific innovation. To address these limitations, we propose an RL framework explicitly tailored for high-quality scientific idea generation. We propose the first multi-agent reward function designed to serve as a judge, decoupling methodological validation from implementation details while providing strict binary rewards that are robust to reward hacking. To effectively optimize against this sparse signal, we utilize an unbiased variant of Group Relative Policy Optimization to mitigate art

translated_title: 辩论即奖励：基于强化学习后训练的面向科学构思的多智能体奖励系统
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在自动化科学构思方面已展现出潜力，然而当前依赖迭代提示或复杂多智能体架构的方法常常存在幻觉或计算效率低下的问题。将强化学习（RL）应用于这一开放式领域的一个关键瓶颈是奖励破解——即模型利用不完善的评估代理来最大化分数，却无法产生真正的科学创新。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了一个明确针对高质量科学想法生成的强化学习框架。我们提出了首个设计为裁判的多智能体奖励函数，将方法论验证与实现细节解耦，同时提供对奖励破解具有鲁棒性的严格二元奖励。为有效针对这一稀疏信号进行优化，我们使用了组相对策略优化（GRPO）的无偏变体来缓解……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个面向科学想法生成的多智能体辩论式奖励函数作为RL训练的裁判，通过解耦方法论验证与实现细节、提供抗奖励破解的严格二元奖励，并结合无偏GRPO变体来应对稀疏奖励信号，从而实现高质量的科学构思。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first multi-agent debate-based reward function acting as a judge for RL-based scientific ideation, decoupling methodological validation from implementation details with binary rewards robust to reward hacking, and employs an unbiased GRPO variant to optimize against the sparse reward signal.
